name: Langtang Gosainkunda Trek
sub_region: Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Sindhupalchok Districts (Langtang National Park; exit via Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park), Bagmati Province

difficulty.notes: Combines the Langtang Valley with the sacred Gosainkunda lakes (4,380 m) and the Laurebina La pass (4,610 m). The pass day (approx. 7-8 hours, about 230 m up and 1,160 m down) and two nights around 4,000 m make it harder than the valley trek alone. [s6, s7]

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu to Kathmandu by road (drive in to Syabrubesi, walk out to Sundarijal)
duration_days.notes: Full loop Langtang Valley + Gosainkunda + Helambu: approx. 13-16 days (Peregrine sells 16). Gosainkunda-only from Dhunche to Sundarijal: approx. 6-7 days. Helambu variant: from Tharepati descend to Melamchi Gaon - Tarkeghyang - Sermathang and drive out from Melamchi Pul Bazaar instead of walking to Sundarijal. Extended versions add the Tamang Heritage Trail (approx. 19 days). In autumn 2026, TAAN advised the reverse approach Sundarijal - Helambu - Gosainkunda - Thulo Syabru - Langtang while the Syabrubesi road was cut. [s6, s8, s9, s10]

max_altitude_point: Tserko Ri (optional day hike from Kyanjin); Laurebina La 4,610 m is the highest pass
end_point: Sundarijal (then approx. 1 hour drive to Kathmandu)

itinerary.notes: 7-9 hours. See langtang-valley-trek for post-flood start changes. [s5, s11]

itinerary.route: Day hike Kyanjin Ri (4,773 m) or Tserko Ri (4,984 m)

itinerary.notes: Sing Gompa given as 3,250-3,330 m; cheese factory. [s6, s8]

itinerary.route: Gosainkunda - Laurebina La (4,610 m) - Phedi - Ghopte
itinerary.notes: Ghopte given as 3,430-3,450 m. [s6, s7, s8]
Helambu variant turns off at Tharepati towards Melamchi Gaon. [s6, s7, s8]
Chisapani given as 2,165-2,215 m. [s6, s7, s8]

itinerary.route: Chisapani - Borlang Bhanjyang - Shivapuri NP - Sundarijal, drive to Kathmandu
itinerary.notes: Sundarijal approx. 1,460 m; separate Shivapuri NP fee. [s6, s7, s8]

avoid: Dec-Feb (Laurebina La often snowed in, lakes frozen)
best_seasons.notes: Gosainkunda draws thousands of Hindu pilgrims at the Janai Purnima full-moon festival (around August). Access from the Syabrubesi side was cut by the 26 Aug 2026 flood; Dhunche reopened by road on 11 Oct 2026 and tourists were reported reaching Gosainkunda on 14 Oct. [s5, s6, s8]

permits.name: Langtang National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; under 10 free)

permits.name: Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park entry permit (exit via Sundarijal)
permits.fee: NPR 1,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 600; under 10 free)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued e-TIMS)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; Langtang Gosaikund Trek and Goshaikunda/Helambu treks are on NTB's guide + TIMS list

guide_requirements: Licensed trekking guide and agency-issued TIMS card mandatory: NTB lists Langtang Trek, Langtang Gosaikund Trek, Helambu Trek and Goshaikunda Trek under the revised TIMS provision effective 31 March 2023. [s2]

drives: Helambu variant: Melamchi Pul Bazaar - Kathmandu: approx. 2-3 hours
logistics.notes: Park checkpoints include Dhunche, Ghoda Tabela and, on the Helambu side, Kutumsang/Mangengoth; Shivapuri permits checked at Sundarijal. [s10, s12]

highlights: Sacred Gosainkunda lake and surrounding lakes (Saraswatikunda, Bhairabkunda)
Laurebina La pass with views of Langtang, Ganesh Himal, Manaslu and Annapurna ranges
Kyanjin Gompa and the Langtang Valley
Walk out to the edge of Kathmandu via Shivapuri NP
risks: Altitude around 4,380-4,610 m on the Gosainkunda section
Snow and ice on Laurebina La in winter/after storms
Flood/landslide road damage on the Rasuwa side (Aug 2026)
Crowding during the Janai Purnima pilgrimage

acclimatization.notes: Acclimatization from the Langtang Valley section helps before the Gosainkunda crossing; Gosainkunda-only treks from Dhunche gain altitude quickly. [s6, s7]

unverified: Minor altitude disagreements: Sing Gompa 3,250-3,330 m, Ghopte 3,430-3,450 m, Chisapani 2,165-2,215 m, Tharepati 3,510-3,690 m.
Status of the Sundarijal-side trail after the late-September 2026 storms was 'not confirmed' per an operator update.
